parts:
Hi,

I have a dataframe like below:

name city   year   population

A       AA   2000          20
A       AB    2001         20
A       AC    2002         20
B       AD    2001         30
B       AA    2002         30
B       AB    2001         30
C       AC    2002          25
C       AB    2002          25

I need to input name in text box for example A and to return new dataset

city year population

 AA   2000          20
 AB    2001         20
 AC    2002         20   

which I can use for further calculations and plotting

Please help
Thx

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Filter dataset based on reactive input
parts:
In your shinyServer function:

library(dplyr)
# Assuming original data is called "citydata"
filtered <- reactive({
  citydata %>% filter(grepl(tolower(input$search), tolower(city), fixed=TRUE))
})

Then everywhere else in your server code, use "filtered()" to get the filtered data frame.
